description: Copy a Git project into a new sandbox and start it: a cloud sandbox by default (uploaded; takes a minute or so), or with local: true one on this machine in a Lima VM (nothing uploaded, no sign-in). Copies what git tracks or would track, never .env files, keys or credentials; up to 200 MiB, 25 MiB a file, 20,000 files.

agent.description: The coding agent to start in the terminal: claude (Claude Code, the default) or codex (Codex).

connect.description: Open a terminal connected to the new sandbox with a coding agent running in it, once it is ready. Defaults to true.

install_lima.description: With local: download Lima 2.2.1 (open source, about 25-40 MB, no admin rights) when it is not installed. Only after the user agrees.

local.description: Create the sandbox on this machine instead of RayTrace's cloud. Use when the user asks for a local sandbox. The first one sets up a Linux VM (several minutes).

name.description: The sandbox's name. Defaults to the project folder's name. A local sandbox's name must be unique on this machine: letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.

path.description: A folder inside the Git project to upload; relative paths are resolved against the workspace. Defaults to the open workspace.

without_beta_credit.description: Create a regular sandbox, not the user's free beta sandbox. Only after the user agrees, when create_sandbox reported their free beta sandbox expired or already created.

name: create_sandbox
title: Create a sandbox
